label: 8-channel NVR with 8-port PoE switch
description: 8-channel 4K NVR with two SATA bays, one gigabit LAN port and eight 10/100 PoE camera ports on a private subnet. The built-in PoE switch supplies 802.3af/at with an 80 W total budget and hands the cameras DHCP from the NVR itself.
notes: Recorder + 8-port PoE switch in one box. PoE out: 802.3af/at, 25.5 W per port, 80 W total budget - four 802.3at PTZs will exhaust it. The PoE ports sit on an internal 192.168.254.0/24 with DHCP enabled, so cameras are double-NATed from the LAN unless bridged. Wired only.
